item.title: 68-year-old man dies at Donaldson Correctional Facility
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) -- A 68-year-old inmate at William Donaldson Correctional Facility has died. Bernie Doyce Skinner, who was receiving treatment for "multiple significant natural diseases," died Wednesday morning, according to the Jefferson County Coroner's Office. The coroner's office said there are currently no signs of foul play associated with Skinner's death.

item.title: Governor Kay Ivey signs Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law
item.description: MONTGOMERY, Ala. (WIAT) -- Governor Kay Ivey signed the Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law Thursday. The Child Predator Death Penalty Act strengthens criminal penalties against those who are convicted of felony sexual crimes against a child.
